why.label: WHY MAGHANIM
why.title: Why Maghanim?
why.body: UAE SMEs juggle multiple vendors for payments, cards, accounting and financing — each with its own contract, portal and support line. Maghanim replaces that patchwork with one integrated platform governed by independent Shariah oversight.

without.heading: Vendors that don't talk to each other.
points: One provider for payments, another for cards, another for accounting
No unified reporting or reconciliation across vendors
Shariah compliance checked vendor by vendor — if at all

with.heading: One platform, one contract, one relationship.
points: Payments, cards, ERP and financing through a single integration
One contract, one relationship manager, one support channel
Independent Shariah governance across every product

why.disclaimer: Maghanim is the platform layer. Each regulated service is delivered by a licensed partner institution.

how.title: How B2B travel settlement works
how.body: A five-step flow that replaces cash, deposits and guarantees with a controlled, single-use card payment.

onboard.label: Onboard
onboard.desc: The travel business is registered and its corporate account is opened.

fund.label: Fund
fund.desc: The wallet is loaded using local payment methods or a linked bank account.

issue.label: Issue
issue.desc: A single-use virtual card is issued against the funded balance.

book.label: Book
book.desc: The booking is completed with the virtual card through existing channels.

settle.label: Settle
settle.desc: The supplier is paid immediately and settled by its existing acquirer.

how.outcome: The supplier receives cleared funds immediately and carries no counterparty credit risk. The travel business releases the capital previously tied up in deposits and guarantees, and gains transaction-level expense control it did not have under cash settlement.

partners.title: Built on regulated infrastructure
partners.body: Maghanim does not seek to replicate licensed banking or processing infrastructure. It integrates it. Each partner supplies a regulated capability; Maghanim supplies the SME relationship, the product design and the Shariah governance layer.
